question: Cual fue el producto top en ingresos de cada trimestre del semestre, y cambio el lider entre el primer y el segundo trimestre?

steps.purpose: top product by revenue in the first quarter
steps.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_revenue FROM sales s JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

steps.purpose: top product by revenue in the second quarter
steps.sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_revenue FROM sales s JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE s.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

plan.answer_needs: two products and their percentage change
